query: To which aircraft carrier was the VMF-213 Marine Fighting Squadron assigned to durning World War II?

pipeline_result.response: The aircraft carrier to which the VMF-213 Marine Fighting Squadron (VMF-213) was assigned during World War II is the USS Missouri (DDG-63), also known as USS Hornet. This particular carrier was part of the 3rd Fleet, specifically the Pacific Fleet, and played a significant role in the early stages of the war.
